name: phoenix-security
description: Phoenix Security skills for Claude Code: AppSec review, threat modelling, SAST rule generation, CTI research, security-first PRDs, readiness gates, and documentation automation.

plugins.name: phoenix-security-review
plugins.description: AppSec review suite: multi-language security-reviewer (8-point check, 7 language packs, OWASP/ASVS + endpoint checklists), whole-repo security-assessment, diff-scoped 0day-scanner, STRIDE/DREAD threat-modeling, and two threat-model-driven tiers (tm-quick-security-assessment, tm-security-review). Ships 4 slash commands, a security-reviewer subagent, and 3 opt-in hooks.

plugins.name: phoenix-readiness-reviews
plugins.description: Two adversarial review gates. plan-readiness-review asks whether a PRD, spec or RFC is implementable without inventing anything. production-readiness-review asks whether the code is actually built, wired, tested and safe to deploy, backed by a deterministic repo scanner.

plugins.name: phoenix-sast-rules
plugins.description: Generate opengrep/semgrep SAST rules for 30+ languages, including pattern and taint-mode rules. The research variant first researches a CVE or CWE with web search, then writes targeted detection rules from the findings.

plugins.name: phoenix-cti-search
plugins.description: Cyber threat intelligence search across 595 curated security domains in 4 authority tiers, for CVEs, threat actors, malware families, exploits and breach reports. Ships a skill that needs no API key, a Node CLI, an MCP server, and a /cti-search command. Optional push to NotebookLM.

plugins.name: phoenix-prd-pipeline
plugins.description: Security-first specification pipeline. prd-generator writes a full PRD with a threat model from a plain-language feature description. The 12 phoenix-* roles run the same pipeline stage by stage: context curation, scope, constraints, RFC 2119 requirements, ambiguity hunting, threat model, API contracts, verification matrix, delivery batches and a final ship gate.

plugins.name: phoenix-docs-research
plugins.description: Documentation and research tooling. project-documenter generates and self-heals a full documentation pack across 6 modes. notebooklm queries Google NotebookLM for citation-backed, source-grounded answers. phoenix-research-pipeline runs web and YouTube research and pushes sources into NotebookLM.
